prompts.A:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE polished portrait character-and-animation concept sheet, 1024x1536 composition, for a proposed boss in MAGIC, a low-poly stylized isometric castle game about telekinesis. This is design concept art, not a screenshot or a finished 3D asset.
Boss A: RUNE COLOSSUS. An ancient living castle-stone guardian, 3.4 metres tall compared with a 1.85m player. Broad massive torso, short stout load-bearing legs, layered hewn stone slabs rather than primitive cuboids, enormous articulated stone forearms, distinct shoulder/elbow/wrist gaps linked by restrained teal magical energy, sculpted blunt stone face and a central removable rune-stone chest core. Stone brow battlements and sparse old brass joint bands. The RIGHT forearm has an integrated broad flat striking slab; do not add a separate weapon. Huge planted feet and readable articulated hip/knee/ankle construction. Chipped bevels and intentional sparse carvings, no excessive microdetail. Cool desaturated slate stone, muted aged brass, small cyan emissive accents. Big rounded/faceted proportions and matte surfaces appropriate to friendly yet threatening KayKit-style castle characters, not realistic horror, not a recoloured armoured soldier.
Layout: warm neutral light-grey background, crisp dark typography, generous gutters and full-body figures with no cropping. Header exactly 'A / RUNE COLOSSUS'. Upper half: large three-quarter full-body hero in a stable stance, a small human mage silhouette as scale reference. Middle row: smaller FRONT and BACK orthographic studies showing the same anatomy, coherent chest core and joint locations. Bottom row: three numbered full-body action keyframes of THE SAME CHARACTER with coherent shapes and materials, on a single continuous stone ground line: '1 WINDUP', '2 IMPACT', '3 RECOVERY'. Windup: knees and hips flex, right striking arm lifts overhead, left foot braces, torso twists and left arm balances. Impact: right arm slams the floor, knees compress, planted feet do not move, small local dust and a flat ground shockwave without concealing limbs. Recovery: striking arm remains briefly on ground, torso bent forward, exposed teal chest core becomes reachable, left hand stabilizes, then prepares to rise. These must be visibly different plausible weight-bearing poses, not duplicate idle poses.
Show a modest compact inset isometric/overhead silhouette near the hero for readability from gameplay camera. Lighting: neutral studio light, readable materials, minimal bloom. No scenery, no UI mockup, no logos, no watermark, no claims of actual animation. Make all joints and contact surfaces visible.
prompts.B:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE polished portrait character-and-animation concept sheet, 1024x1536 composition, for boss B of MAGIC, a low-poly stylized isometric castle game about telekinesis. This is design concept art, not a gameplay screenshot or finished asset.
Boss B: BELFRY GARGOYLE. A sculpted living gargoyle monster, entirely distinct from an armoured humanoid stone golem: lean forward-leaning crouched body, long neck with short batlike head, two curved horns, TWO separate functional grasping arms, TWO digitigrade hind legs with three toes, ONE articulated tapering tail, and TWO large independently articulated bat wings attached symmetrically to the upper back. Weathered dark-purple slate body, subtly ochre/terracotta wing membranes with faceted ribs, amber eyes, small muted gold bell collar. It should look like a believable stylized monster statue guarding a castle tower. Full wing span roughly 4.8m, standing height 2.6m compared to a small 1.85m human mage silhouette. No sword, axe, shield or plate armour. Charming chunky faceted low-poly aesthetic and matte surfaces, production-readable broad shapes, no photoreal horror or noisy microdetail.
Layout matches a clear professional design board on a warm neutral light grey background: header exactly 'B / BELFRY GARGOYLE'. Upper half: large three-quarter full-body hero, crouched with two back wings partly unfolded, visible separate forearms, tail, hips, knees, ankles and grounded toe contacts. Small human silhouette for scale, compact overhead/isometric inset to show readable V-shaped wings from the game camera. Middle row: coherent FRONT and BACK anatomical studies with the same horn shape, wing attachments and tail; wing membranes stretched between ribs, wings must fold without passing through torso or arms.
Bottom row, three numbered keyframes of THE SAME gargoyle, clearly separated with enough room for wings, on a continuous ground line: '1 TAKEOFF', '2 DIVE', '3 LANDING'. Takeoff: hind legs push off, wings drive down, torso accelerates upward, tail trails. Dive: wings tuck back symmetrically into a narrow arrow shape, neck forward, arms extend forward, hind legs sweep back; show entire airborne body. Landing: both hind toes planted, knees/hips bent deeply, wings flare to brake, forearms reach toward the ground for stabilization, tail curves upward; creature is momentarily vulnerable while folding the wings. Plausible anatomy and distinctly different poses, no copied idle figures. Restrained dust only at takeoff/landing, no magical smoke obscuring the anatomy.
Neutral studio light with clean sculpted forms and readable silhouettes. All limbs inside frame, typography legible and sparse, no unrelated scenery, no logos, no watermark, no claim of actual animation.
prompts.C:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE polished portrait character-and-animation concept sheet, 1024x1536 composition, for boss C in MAGIC, a low-poly stylized isometric castle game about telekinesis. This is design concept art, not a screenshot or a finished 3D asset.
Boss C: CHAIN WRAITH. An ancient spectral jailer with a clearly NON-HUMAN floating silhouette. Tall slim pointed hood above a hollow shadow face with two small pale mint eyes, a tattered faceted cloak that tapers into three floating wisps, absolutely no legs and no feet. TWO coherent shoulder/elbow/wrist articulated spectral arms with iron cuffs. Two long continuous visibly linked iron chains: one chain visibly attached to each wrist cuff, each ending in ONE large bronze/iron rune-weight about the size of the head. The left and right chains are separately identifiable and never merge. Tangible weathered bronze collar, dark moss-black/charcoal opaque faceted mantle, pale mint-green energy only in hollow face and a thin lower edge, dark iron links and muted warm brass weights. Few large surfaces and readable curved shapes rather than excessive fabric microdetail, no dense smoke. It is distinct from both a golem and a winged gargoyle; no wing, no legs, no sword, no plate armour, no throne. Stylized friendly-dark-fantasy proportions and matte low-poly 3D render aesthetic appropriate to a castle game, not realistic horror.
Height 2.8m including hood, levitates 0.45m above floor. Small 1.85m human mage scale silhouette. Chain weapons give an unmistakable wide curved silhouette visible from an isometric camera.
Layout: warm neutral light-grey background, clear typography, generous gutters and complete figures. Header exactly 'C / CHAIN WRAITH'. Upper half: large three-quarter full-body hero with one arm forward and one to the side, both chains attached continuously to their cuffs and rune-weights resting or hovering just above the ground, hood and floating lower cloak fully visible. Small human silhouette and compact overhead/isometric inset showing chain arcs. Middle row: coherent FRONT and BACK views of the same character, showing cuffs, chain anchors, cape segmentation and absence of legs, with uncluttered spacing.
Bottom row: three numbered motion-design keyframes of THE SAME wraith with consistent cuffs and continuous chains, above one stone ground line: '1 WINDUP', '2 SWEEP', '3 RECOIL'. Windup: shoulders turn, torso tilts opposite the intended swing, right elbow lifts and pulls its chain backward while the heavy rune-weight lags below. Sweep: right arm extends across the body, right attached chain forms a wide horizontal arc, weight travels outward; left arm and left chain counterbalance low and behind, mantle twists with torso; use just one subtle directional arrow. Recoil: a small plain grey telekinetically-thrown stone has hit the exposed bronze chest collar, torso folds back and shoulders recoil, arms drop, both chain weights fall and links slacken, cloak trails with delayed follow-through. No gore. Poses must show anticipation, cause/effect, weight lag and follow-through rather than repeated idle silhouettes.
Neutral studio lighting, very restrained emissive light, no bloom hiding anatomy, no scattered unrelated props, no logos, no watermark, no claim of actual animation. Keep chain continuity mechanically credible and readable.
